query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: A bustling, vibrant street in Hanoi's Old Quarter famous for its energetic nightlife. Lined with tiny plastic stools, it's the ultimate spot to experience local street food, grilled skewers, and fresh local beer (Bia Hoi) alongside locals and travelers [2.3.1].
places.opening_hours: Friday - Sunday: 7:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Individual vendors vary daily)
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Chợ đêm Đồng Xuân - ngành hàng ẩm thực
places.text: Located at the iconic Dong Xuan Market, this dedicated night food section comes alive with street vendors selling an array of Vietnamese delicacies, from piping hot cháo sườn (rib porridge) to grilled pork skewers and sweet desserts.
places.opening_hours: Open Friday, Saturday, and Sunday nights
places.address: 2RPX+WWW Chợ Đồng Xuân, Ng. Đồng Xuân, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: Arguably Hanoi's most famous banh mi spot, this popular stall serves exceptionally crispy, fresh French baguettes stuffed with high-quality pâté, roasted meats, pickles, and fresh herbs, with fantastic vegetarian and vegan options available.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: Phố ẩm thực Tống Duy Tân
places.text: Known as Hanoi's premier 24-hour food street, Tong Duy Tan is lined with endless eateries serving iconic street foods like cơm đảo gà rang (sizzling fried rice with chicken), hotpots, and traditional Vietnamese steamed dishes.
places.address: 2RHV+FHW, Cấm Chỉ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn
places.text: A legendary establishment globally celebrated for serving some of the finest authentic beef pho in Hanoi. Expect to queue up with locals for a steaming, richly aromatic bowl of tender beef noodles crafted from a long-held family recipe.
places.opening_hours: Monday - Sunday: 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM, 5:00 PM – 9:30 PM
places.address: 49 P. Bát Đàn, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
